Floating mix-blend-difference nav. Yellow 'IC' square logo tile + 'Iron Cesspool Auto' wordmark in Anton uppercase + JetBrains Mono nav links + filled-yellow 'Get Estimate' CTA. Mobile gets a simple ☰ glyph.

REAL REPAIRS.' in Inter bold (NOT display) + supporting paragraph + dual CTAs (yellow 'Call (216) 555-0142' + outline 'See What We Fix'). ASE MASTER / BBB A+ / AAA APPROVED / EST. 1987 trust badges in 4-col grid; each card has a 'BADGE-0X' ref code above the badge name in yellow mono bold.

Three service blocks (BRAKES / ENGINE & DIAGNOSTICS / TRANSMISSION) alternating left/right. Each has SVC-XXX // SVC-NAME ref code, stencil heading, paragraph, and image with a yellow IMG-REF-XXXXX tag tab in the bottom-left corner.
'THE WORKFLOW' stencil heading + 5 cards (DROP OFF / DIAGNOSE / QUOTE / FIX / PICKUP) each with a small circle-number badge floating above the top edge.
'WORD OF MOUTH' stencil heading + 'REV-SUMMARY // 4.9/5.0' ref code; three glass cards each with oversized serif quote glyph, italic review, and uppercase mono author + city below a thin top border.
'WE COME TO YOU' with town list. Each town is a mono-text item with a yellow border-left-2 accent bar.

Left: 'GET AN ESTIMATE' stencil head + mono inputs (NAME / PHONE / VEHICLE / ISSUE) + 'SEND REQUEST' yellow CTA. Right: grayscale-filtered embedded Google Maps iframe in a min-height 400px box with yellow MAP-REF tag corner badge.
Address column + Hours column + Contact column with mono type throughout. Bottom strip says '1987 – 2026 IRON CESSPOOL AUTO. THIRD GENERATION.'

hero_signature: 1A1A1A near-black background with two huge yellow-glow blurred blobs (700px + 400px) in top-right and bottom-left. A monospace REF-2026-ICA reference code sits in the top-right corner as if stenciled onto a job ticket. The H1 is INTENTIONALLY in Inter bold (not the display Anton) — 'HONEST DIAGNOSTICS. notable_features: Fixed top yellow-and-black diagonal hazard stripe (4px tall, repeating-linear-gradient at 45deg) — load-bearing visual signature
Stencil text utility: -webkit-text-stroke 1px in body color + transparent fill + Anton font for hollow-letter section headlines
JetBrains Mono ref-code system: every section labeled with REF-XXX / SVC-XXX / BADGE-0X / IMG-REF / MAP-REF / INQ-XXX -- treats the site like a parts catalog
Yellow IMG-REF tag corner tabs on every photo (yellow rectangle with mono text)
Grayscale + contrast filter on photography for industrial look
Grayscale-filtered embedded Google Maps iframe (filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0.6))
mix-blend-difference nav so the IC tile and wordmark invert against any background
Process step number badges floating half-outside the top edge of each card
Yellow border-left-2 vertical accent bars on service-area town list
All-caps city + state stamp under each review name in mono
Glass card with backdrop-blur(12px) + 4% white tint
motion_vocabulary: GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals: y/x 48px translate + opacity 0->1, power3.out 800ms
Alternating service blocks slide from opposite sides (-translate-x-12 vs translate-x-12)
Navbar adds bg-bg + bg-opacity-90 after 100px scroll
Image hover: scale-105 + grayscale-0.2 + contrast-110 transform-duration 700ms
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .hazard-stripe (fixed 4px repeating-linear-gradient diagonal yellow/dark), .stencil (Anton + webkit-text-stroke 1px + transparent fill + tracking 0.05em uppercase), .stencil-filled (filled Anton variant), .ref-code (JetBrains Mono 0.65rem uppercase tracking 0.15em at 32%-alpha body), .text-outline (alt stroke utility), .glass-card (white 4% tint + blur 12px + 10%-white border). Custom scrollbar with yellow thumb hover.
